usage: Emit as BLOCKER=<code>. Never report a failure in prose without a code from this taxonomy.

blockers.detection_rule: A required authority artifact is absent or unparseable.
blockers.invalidation_scope: A0 only, while A1 has not started

blockers.detection_rule: The machine authority and the Markdown authority disagree on a frozen value, or two supplemental files disagree.
A settled Phase 0 decision is contradicted, impossible, or has a missing dependency that makes it unimplementable.
blockers.required_evidence: PHASE1_BLOCKER report naming the decision, the code evidence, and the minimum prospective amendment
blockers.invalidation_scope: Authority construction halts on that decision

blockers.detection_rule: A controlling decision exists only in the Phase 0 or Fable documents and is not reproduced in the authority.
A proposed change alters a frozen scientific decision (section 9.2 or the 9.3 decision test).
blockers.required_evidence: Amendment request naming the decision, the reason, the minimum change, and the invalidation set

blockers.detection_rule: A change-matrix item is not COMPLETE, or its named tests do not pass.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected task and its dependents

blockers.detection_rule: Any group-A or group-B test fails, errors, or a group-A test is skipped.
The recorded source closure digest does not match the current worktree closure.
blockers.required_evidence: static_validation_receipt.json / stage receipt source closure field
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every receipt bound to the superseded closure

blockers.detection_rule: Observed MineWorld checkpoint SHA-256 != a92c311baf49bbf31338da2caaadc9e4f947b94df8abcf75da350c4ae41319c5.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every extraction bound to the wrong checkpoint
Every extraction bound to the wrong VAE

blockers.detection_rule: Minecraft, Fabric loader, Fabric API, Yarn mappings, or mod jar hash differs from the frozen pins.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every capture taken under the wrong runtime

blockers.detection_rule: Client framebuffer is not exactly 640x360.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every capture and P0 frame at the wrong size

blockers.detection_rule: No CUDA device, or insufficient GPU memory for the 20-layer transient hook set.
blockers.invalidation_scope: A9 cannot run on this host

blockers.detection_rule: No display available for the Minecraft client.
blockers.invalidation_scope: A4, A5, A7 cannot run on this host

blockers.detection_rule: Preprocessing or action-conversion identity differs from the frozen historical bytes.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every extraction under the wrong preprocessing

blockers.detection_rule: The server or client process fails to launch or arm within the frozen launch attempt bound.
blockers.required_evidence: Launch attempt history in the stage log

blockers.detection_rule: startspec is refused, or the arming line does not carry the declared episode, seed, and immutable schedule.
Fewer than 13 LEFT_TO_RIGHT or 12 RIGHT_TO_LEFT candidates satisfy all TWELVE gates of authority section 2.4 within the frozen candidate index bound of 2000 per direction.
The RNG stream fixture does not reproduce the frozen reference path hash.
blockers.required_evidence: RNG stream fixture output; environment_receipt.json NumPy version
blockers.invalidation_scope: The whole cohort if regenerated under the drifted stream
blockers.resume_point: A1 after pinning a stream-compatible NumPy

blockers.detection_rule: Any Experiment III spec, path, manifest, or validator carries speed 1.5 or any value other than 2.0.
blockers.required_evidence: Manifest field speed_blocks_per_second; source audit of 1.5-bearing literals
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every artifact validated at the wrong speed

blockers.detection_rule: A seed repeats within Experiment III, or appears in the historical exclusion set.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected identity, while no capture exists

blockers.detection_rule: Complete five-way paired identities < 15.
blockers.invalidation_scope: No graded inferential claim; analysis proceeds only as a no-claim closure
blockers.resume_point: A7 to capture more units while the deadline allows

blockers.detection_rule: The identity x condition matrix disagrees with the ledger or the manifests.
A pilot identity (e3_p90, e3_p91) appears in any production manifest, fold, fit, metric, or statistic.
No triple from the twelve-candidate roster satisfies every rule of authority 7.5, with clean measurement.
blockers.required_evidence: P0_SELECTION_RECEIPT with every rule evaluated per triple
blockers.invalidation_scope: PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED stays false; Experiment III stops and returns to authority adjudication

blockers.detection_rule: The measurement itself is untrustworthy: mask, noise, background, replicate, capture, or QA failure.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected (condition, placement, block) units only

blockers.detection_rule: A requested block ID is not in the frozen twelve-candidate roster, or is not resolvable in the 1.16.5 registry.
The authoritative projected sheep center is outside the frozen placement tolerance.
An L0 support mask is empty, or its pixel count is outside the frozen plausibility bounds.
Outside-mask present/absent residual exceeds the frozen background tolerance.
Within-placement replicate coefficient of variation > 0.15 where the mean is nonzero.
L3 excess-energy-to-noise ratio < 5 at more than one of the nine placements.
blockers.invalidation_scope: That triple is invalid; other triples may still qualify

blockers.detection_rule: The strict L1>L2>L3 order holds at fewer than eight of nine placements.
blockers.invalidation_scope: That triple is invalid; other triples may still qualify

blockers.detection_rule: A 10,000-resample placement bootstrap lower bound for an adjacent difference is <= 0.
blockers.invalidation_scope: That triple is invalid; other triples may still qualify

blockers.detection_rule: Sentinel RVE order across the three frozen placements does not match P0.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected as-yet-unmodeled capture batch only

blockers.detection_rule: A sentinel score falls outside the frozen repeatability envelope.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected as-yet-unmodeled capture batch only

blockers.detection_rule: Any item of the section 6A verification list is unproven, or a count mismatches.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The pilot receipt; re-pilot the affected span

blockers.detection_rule: A deliberate mid-run kill and restart did not resume same-spec, or recomputed an already-DURABLE unit.
A required freeze binding is missing, null, or a placeholder.
A freeze binding does not verify against its live artifact.
Any of A0-A5 lacks a PASS receipt bound to this authority.
Replayed positions differ from logged sheep_x by more than 1e-9, or the recomputed path hash differs from the manifest.
The recomputed noise schedule hash differs from the manifest.
Fewer than 180 frame PNGs, or a gap in the frame index.
Fewer than 180 action rows, or a gap in server_tick.
Fewer than 180 server_state rows, or a gap in server_tick.
A run of byte-identical consecutive frames exceeds the frozen staleness tolerance.
blockers.required_evidence: Framebuffer hash sequence in the frame inventory
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected capture unit or P0 block only

blockers.detection_rule: The replay comparison requires the [-8,8] clamp to bind in order to match the logged position.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected capture unit; the identity's qualification is also suspect

blockers.detection_rule: The realized capture order differs from the frozen Latin schedule.
blockers.required_evidence: capture_matrix.json realized order versus the frozen plan

blockers.detection_rule: len(server_state), len(client_tick), len(actions), and len(frames) are not all exactly 180.
server_tick != index on any stream, or client and server frame alignment disagrees.
An observed wall cell holds a block other than the condition's frozen registry ID.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected capture unit; and every unit since the last verified transition

blockers.detection_rule: A wall cell inside the frozen footprint is air when it should be filled, or a cell outside it is non-air.
A material transition did not force an arena rebuild, detectable as a wall receipt showing the previous material.
blockers.required_evidence: wall_receipt.json plus the arena rebuild log
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every capture taken since the missed rebuild

blockers.detection_rule: Observed runtime scene does not equal the condition's expected scene (L0 -> NO_WALL, L1-L4 -> NORMAL).
declared_block_id does not equal the condition's frozen registry ID, or mismatches are nonzero.
Observed camera feet, eye, yaw, pitch, roll, or FOV differs from the frozen pose by more than 1e-6, or camera lock is inactive.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected capture unit or P0 block

blockers.detection_rule: More than one target entity UUID across the 180 frames, or a required target flag is not observed.
target_respawn_count != 0.
The 19 realized target rows differ from the frozen manifest indices.
Two conditions of the same identity carry different target indices or labels.
classify_visibility, assign_stable_hidden_tau, or tau-based target construction is reachable on the Experiment III path.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every target manifest produced with a legacy selector

blockers.detection_rule: Any acceptance gate of authority 5.3 step 4 fails: rank != 9, a negative tap, tap sum outside 1 +/- 1e-9, max residual > 1e-12, aggregate mode lag != 2, or support outside [0,8].
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every FIR label and therefore the whole cohort

blockers.detection_rule: The counterfactual WallGeometry is constructed with present=False for any condition, including L0.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every target manifest computed with the wrong presence flag

blockers.detection_rule: A target row index < 8, so the 9-tap kernel lacks complete causal history.
git show a5d763a:<path> fails for any required ported file, or the retrieved blob SHA-1 differs from the recorded value.
Observed forward count exceeds one per target row (2,375 in normal production).
A serialized slice does not correspond to python slice [4858:5194] or [5205:5541].
blockers.required_evidence: Token-position hash in the array metadata
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every array with the wrong slice

blockers.detection_rule: A unit's recorded source capture hash does not match the current kept capture.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every array derived from the changed capture

blockers.detection_rule: A unit's recorded extraction spec hash does not match the current plan.
blockers.resume_point: A9 from the start of extraction

blockers.detection_rule: The realized array count, logical tensor count, or byte total differs from the recomputed expectation.
The scoped hook manager did not produce exactly 20 handles, or a callback did not fire.
blockers.required_evidence: Hook manager completeness assertion in the extraction log

blockers.detection_rule: A capture for layer 4, 10, or 19 is absent after the forward.
spans[-1] or spans[-2] does not equal its expected pair index or visual position tuple.
A selected visual position overlaps an action-token position (5194-5204 or 5541-5551).
spans[-1].identity.model_frame_idx != t, or spans[-2].identity.model_frame_idx != t-1.
The FrameTokenMap does not cover range(5552) exactly, or a position is duplicated or missing.
The context-age boundary (present for a<=15, absent for a>=16) was not verified from explicit frame identities.
blockers.required_evidence: Frame-identity verification record in the extraction receipt

blockers.detection_rule: A persisted array is not exactly [19,336,2048].
A persisted array is not little-endian float16.
A persisted .npy is not exactly 26,148,992 bytes.
A persisted array contains a NaN or an infinity.
A re-hashed array does not match its recorded SHA-256.
A feature block is not 24,576 (CURRENT, CURRENT_MINUS_PREVIOUS), 49,152 (TWO_FRAME_CONCAT), or 4,032 (pixel).
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected feature block and every downstream fit

blockers.detection_rule: The identity-encoding pooling fixture does not reproduce byte-identically, indicating a 14x24 versus 24x14 transposition.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every feature block and every downstream fit

blockers.detection_rule: TWO_FRAME_CONCAT places CURRENT before PREVIOUS, or the subtraction sign is inverted.
Feature block row order does not equal the frozen target-row order.
A feature block contains a NaN or an infinity.
An identity appears in its own training set, or a scaler/alpha was fit using held-out rows.
Any of the five frozen baselines has no locked prediction.
A baseline coefficient or mean was fit using held-out identities or rows.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The affected baseline and every contrast using it

blockers.detection_rule: A baseline does not match its frozen formula (for example a constant-velocity window other than 10).
Last-seen or constant-velocity oracle state appears in any model feature.
A results stage ran without PREDICTION_LOCK.json, or a reported number does not derive from it.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every result computed without the lock

blockers.detection_rule: A summary statistic file predates PREDICTION_LOCK.json.
blockers.required_evidence: File timestamps and stage ledger ordering
blockers.invalidation_scope: The prospective status of the analysis

blockers.detection_rule: An (identity, condition, row, model) cell has more than one held-out prediction.
A locked prediction is NaN or infinite.
Alpha selection used any held-out identity.
An analysis stage read features or fitted values instead of locked predictions.
The primary family is not exactly the three frozen estimands, or a secondary family gained or lost a member.
Any overall experiment pass/fail verdict, discontinuity ratio, or reproduction band appears.
blockers.required_evidence: Results files and the statistical report

blockers.detection_rule: Age bins are not exactly 1-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-19, or the interaction windows are not 12-15 and 16-19.
A reported claim has no matching permitted interpretation in the adjudication matrix, or appears in the prohibited list.
An obtaining outcome row was not adjudicated.
Holm was applied across a number of p-values other than exactly 3 (primary) or exactly 2 (temporal).
The bootstrap resampled rows or captures rather than whole identities with all conditions kept together.
blockers.required_evidence: Bootstrap configuration in the results file
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every interval computed with the wrong unit

blockers.detection_rule: The bootstrap seed differs from the value bound in P2.
An identity/condition cell has zero total sum of squares, making per-identity R2 undefined.
blockers.invalidation_scope: That identity's R2 only; RMSE and MAE remain valid

blockers.detection_rule: Free working disk is below the frozen preflight threshold.
A write fails for lack of space mid-stage.
The durable store cannot be reached or the round trip fails.
A downloaded object's byte count or SHA-256 differs from the local artifact.
An artifact records an AUTHORITY_SHA256 different from the current authority.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Every artifact bound to the superseded authority

blockers.detection_rule: An Experiment III process wrote to a path owned by Regime A, Regime A-prime, or Experiment II.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The offending unit; the historical artifact must be restored from git

blockers.detection_rule: A persisted array lacks a required provenance field.
A required package artifact is absent.
A package artifact's hash differs from its source receipt.
A figure or table cannot be traced to a locked prediction or a receipt.
A frozen clock trigger fired before production launch.
blockers.invalidation_scope: Scope is reduced to the selected fallback plan; already-captured units are preserved

blockers.detection_rule: A fallback plan was chosen using any scientific outcome rather than time and status alone.
blockers.invalidation_scope: The prospective status of the reduced design

blockers.detection_rule: Any of the eight closure conditions is unmet.
The live status document fails LIVE_STATUS_CONTRACT.json validation, or COMPLETED_UNITS + REMAINING_UNITS != TOTAL_UNITS.
blockers.invalidation_scope: None. The status surface is observational; a malformed document never invalidates scientific work.

blockers.detection_rule: CURRENT_BLOCKER is non-null but is not a code in this taxonomy.
blockers.invalidation_scope: None scientifically, but the real underlying failure is unclassified and must be given a taxonomy code before the stage may exit.
blockers.resume_point: The running stage; classify the failure first

blockers.detection_rule: The oracle does not reproduce the frozen S(tau) table to 1e-12, or a non-positive sigma appears for tau in 1..19, or the affine form is detected below tau=8, or the FIR coherence check fails at a new q.
Standard normals differ across q for a fixed seed, or noise_draw != z*sqrt(q*dt), or the q=0.05 regression does not reproduce the frozen A-prime path hash.
blockers.invalidation_scope: III-B manifests; AND the III-A cohort if the defect reaches the shared generator, in which case section 9 applies

blockers.detection_rule: The q=0.2 pilot fails the predeclared TECHNICAL trajectory/window/FIR qualification gate.
blockers.invalidation_scope: q_high only; exactly one fallback re-pilot at q=0.15 is permitted

blockers.detection_rule: The q=0.15 fallback was selected for any reason other than failure of the technical qualification gate - for example undesirable model results, uncertainty separation judged too easy or too hard, disappointing decoder results, or a weak U2/U3 effect size.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_pilot_receipt.json trigger field and its inputs
blockers.invalidation_scope: the prospective status of the entire III-B module

blockers.detection_rule: One or more of the eight launch requirements failed at both the 12:00 and the 17:00 evaluation.
blockers.invalidation_scope: None. III-B is cleanly skipped and III-A is unaffected.

blockers.detection_rule: Fewer complete identity q-triples remain than the selected drop level requires.
blockers.invalidation_scope: III-B only; apply the frozen drop ladder

blockers.detection_rule: A cell has no clamp-free, full-context, post-occlusion run of VIS_ROWS stable-visible frames.
blockers.invalidation_scope: That cell contributes no visible-control rows. U2 and U3 are unaffected: visible rows serve descriptive controls only.

blockers.detection_rule: A III-B array fails shape, dtype, byte-size, finiteness or hash validation, or the forward count exceeds the plan.
blockers.invalidation_scope: the affected III-B arrays only; III-A activations are never invalidated by a III-B extraction failure

blockers.detection_rule: A U2 statistic could not be computed, predictions were not locked before a statistic, or a required confound control is missing.
A U3 statistic or a calibration component could not be computed, or coverage was reported as a calibration failure when the mean gate had failed.
blockers.invalidation_scope: III-B U3 and calibration results only

blockers.detection_rule: The U2 Holm family is not exactly 3 statistics (or exactly 2 under the frozen drop LEVEL_1), or the U3 family is not exactly 2, or a statistic was added or removed after results.
Cells were matched across q by absolute model-frame index rather than by occlusion age tau, or a cell's target window was inherited from another q instead of derived from its own path.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_q_manifests.jsonl and the U2 join keys

blockers.detection_rule: Two q variants of the same identity fall in different outer folds or inner rotations, or an identity appears in its own training set across q.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_q_manifests.jsonl fold columns; U2 fold audit

blockers.detection_rule: A frozen clock trigger or the Thursday 2026-09-03 20:00 absolute stop was reached with III-B incomplete.
blockers.invalidation_scope: III-B scope is reduced to the selected drop level, or III-B is cleanly skipped. Already-captured and already-extracted III-B units are preserved. III-A is never delayed.

blockers.detection_rule: Any III-A stage, artifact, estimand, fold, prediction or statistic is found to depend on a III-B product, violating the III-A invariant.
blockers.required_evidence: the dependency audit in AUTHORITY_VALIDATION_REPORT.md and the stage receipts
blockers.invalidation_scope: the offending dependency must be removed; III-A must be re-validated as independent

blockers.detection_rule: Gate 12 (ALL_Q_PROSPECTIVE_QUALIFICATION) cannot be satisfied: fewer than 13 LEFT_TO_RIGHT or 12 RIGHT_TO_LEFT candidates satisfy the per-candidate gates 1-8, 10 and 11 at EVERY frozen q (gate 9 being peer-dependent and evaluated once at the III-A q) in {0.0125, 0.05, 0.2} within the frozen candidate index bound of 2000 per direction. Also fires if the q-generalized qualification primitive (IB02) or its q=0.05 bit-identity regression fixture (IB03) is absent or failing when I02 attempts cohort materialization, in which case cohort materialization MUST fail closed rather than materialize an unqualified cohort.
blockers.required_evidence: cohort_all_q_qualification_receipt.json enumerating every candidate index, its seed, and its first failing gate AT EACH q, plus the q=0.05 regression receipt
blockers.retry_semantics: Retry means: continue scanning candidates in ascending index up to the frozen bound, or repair an implementation defect and rerun the identical deterministic procedure. It NEVER means relaxing gate 12, relaxing gates 1-11 at any q, dropping a q level from the binding set, changing the master salt, or consulting any outcome.
blockers.authority_amendment_required_if: the frozen candidate index bound of 2000 per direction is exhausted without admitting the full cohort
blockers.invalidation_scope: A1 cohort artifacts only, and only while no capture exists
blockers.resume_point: I02 cohort materialization, after IB02 and IB03 are green
blockers.note: This blocker exists because gate 12 is a III-A admission constraint evaluated at A1. It is NOT a III-B stage failure and never makes III-A depend on III-B.

blockers.detection_rule: Task I02 (cohort materialization) is reached while task IB02 (q-generalized path and qualification primitive) or IB03 (q=0.05 bit-identity regression fixture) is not COMPLETE with its named tests passing. Gate 12 is then not evaluable and the cohort must not be materialized.
blockers.required_evidence: implementation_completion_receipt.json showing IB02/IB03 status and the I02 attempt
blockers.invalidation_scope: I02 and its dependents; no cohort artifact is written
blockers.note: Fails CLOSED. Materializing a cohort without gate 12 is the exact defect this repair pass exists to prevent.

blockers.detection_rule: The calibration positivity guard differs from the frozen rule sigma_tilde = max(sigma_hat, 1e-4 blocks): EPS changed; the guard applied to a statistic listed under does_not_apply_to; the guard applied to U2 or U3; the guard applied before prediction lock; the locked predictions storing clipped rather than raw sigma_hat; or fraction_clipped not reported for a calibration analysis that used sigma_tilde.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_calibration_report.json recording EPS, fraction_clipped, count_negative and min_sigma_hat, bound to iii_b_u2_prediction_lock.json

blockers.detection_rule: The emitted inference departs from experiment_iii_b.inferential_procedure: an interval described as Holm-adjusted; significance declared from an interval instead of a Holm-adjusted p-value; a missing p-value for any family member; a p-value construction other than the frozen permutation (U2-S1) or bootstrap inversion (U2-S2, U2-S3, U3-S1, U3-S2); a two-sided p-value where the frozen procedure is one-sided; a Holm multiplier other than the frozen family size; or a calibration statistic entered into a Holm family.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_u2_results.json and iii_b_u3_results.json recording, per statistic, the raw p-value, the Holm-adjusted p-value, the family size, the family member order and the unadjusted interval

blockers.detection_rule: U2-S2 residualizes on tau only, or on any nuisance structure other than the frozen 30 tau-by-direction cells; or ranks within cells instead of over the pooled set; or residualizes before ranking; or drops singleton cells instead of retaining them with a zero residual; or fails to recompute ranking and residualization inside each bootstrap replicate.
blockers.required_evidence: iii_b_u2_results.json recording the nuisance cell count (30), the residualization order, and the singleton-cell handling
blockers.note: tau-only conditioning leaves a direction confound: sigma_oracle depends on direction through H_direction(m), so a direction-only decoder with zero q sensitivity could produce a positive U2-S2.

blockers.detection_rule: Kernel taps are used without fsum normalization: math.fsum(loaded_taps) differs from 1.0 by more than 0 after load, or the derived cumulative masses H(0..8) differ from III_B_ORACLE_SPECIFICATION.json by more than 1e-12, or S(tau) differs from the frozen table by more than 1e-12.
blockers.required_evidence: fir_kernel_recovery_receipt.json recording raw_tap_fsum and the post-normalization agreement with the oracle specification
blockers.invalidation_scope: FIR labels, the target manifest, and every oracle quantity
blockers.note: Unnormalized taps pass the 1e-9 label tolerance but fail the 1e-12 S(tau) tolerance by up to 9.29e-10 in the LEFT_TO_RIGHT direction.

blockers.detection_rule: A storage gate is evaluated against two logical categories that resolve to the SAME device/volume id, so the same free bytes satisfy two requirements; or free space is compared in decimal GB against a binary GiB threshold; or a remote object store is treated as a local free-space gate; or the durability mode is not recorded.
blockers.required_evidence: environment_receipt_<host>.json recording every gated path, its device id, its free bytes, the durability mode, and the gate applied
blockers.invalidation_scope: the environment receipt and every later receipt bound to it

blockers.detection_rule: An implementation checkpoint instant of deadline_fallbacks.implementation_checkpoints passed with its required milestone unmet. Not a failure in itself: it MANDATES the named fallback action (defer III-B-only implementation, or escalate the frozen plan). Fires as a defect only if the mandated action was not taken and recorded.
blockers.required_evidence: deadline_decision_receipt.json recording the instant, the milestone state, the action taken and the plan selected
blockers.resume_point: A1 or A2 under the newly selected plan

outcome_vocabulary.CLEAN_SKIP: III-B was never launched or was dropped by the frozen time/resource ladder. An honourable, pre-registered outcome. NOT a failure and NOT a technical blocker.
outcome_vocabulary.TECHNICAL_FAIL: Something broke. Repairable under the frozen repair policy. NOT a scientific result.
outcome_vocabulary.SCIENTIFIC_NULL: A valid III-B measurement that did not support U2/U3. A publishable scientific result. NEVER reported as a blocker.
outcome_vocabulary.SCIENTIFIC_VIOLATION: A frozen scientific rule was broken. Requires adjudication, not a retry.
outcome_vocabulary.INFORMATIONAL: Recorded for coverage reporting; changes no scientific conclusion.
